name: dayfile
description: Read and write your Markdown-file journal: search, On This Day, append to today.
long_description: Dayfile keeps entries as plain Markdown files in a folder you own. This extension runs the bundled `dayfile` CLI as an MCP server over stdio with 11 tools (list, search, get, on_this_day, entries_on_date, tags, journals, create, append_to_today, update, delete). It uses the folder the Dayfile desktop app is set to, or ~/Journal.

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: List entries, newest first, with filters

tools.name: on_this_day
tools.description: Entries from this day in other years

tools.name: append_to_today
tools.description: Append a paragraph to today's entry

tools.name: update_entry
tools.description: Update body, tags, star or journal
